en:
Kamurocho is ours.
It is about time we prove it.

Urgh... That trash bag...
What did I do wrong...?
I don't get it... Why?

That blast looked pretty strong.
Are you hurt?

I-I think I'm okay, yeah...
You saw it, too?
I thought that bag was suspicious...

I didn't think it'd actually explode, though...
There must've been a bomb in there!

The bag, huh...
There's no way to trace it, then.

I saw the guy, though!
I watched him put that bag there!

It was a guy in his 40's wearing a yellow tracksuit.
Pretty sure he was Chinese.

Chinese? Wait, was he with the Saio?
The guy on the screen was against them, though...
I don't have a clue.

All I know for sure is I heard the guy who
put that trash bag there speaking Chinese.
And where did you hear him?
Over at the Yoshida Batting Center.
That trash bag exploded!
I saw the whole thing.

Hm? You there.
You want to hear about the explosion, too?

Well, the bomb went off right next to me.
I thought I was done for...

I remember.
I was around here when it happened.

Really!? You were there, too?
Then, I'll tell you...

The guy who planted that bomb was definitely Chinese.
He was in a yellow tracksuit over at the batting center.

(So the guy who planted the bomb
is over at the batting center...)
(He should be wearing a yellow tracksuit.)
What you want?

You're Chinese, right?
Are you with the Saio Triad?

I've run into all sorts of Chinese here,
but every one of them was Saio.

I not part of Saio Triad.
I no think like them.
Well then... who are you?

You say who you are first!
We only just meet, but you annoy me!

Somebody told me they saw you leaving
a black trash bag over on Tenkaichi Street.

I was there when the bag exploded.
I saw everything.
You planted that bomb, didn't you?

Who tell you they saw me there?
Was it information desk guy?
What if it was?

I knew it, he looking at me whole time.
Now he know my face.

I shut him up later.
But now, I shut you up!
Who <font_kind=yakuza_italic>are</font_kind> you!?

That's what I want you to tell me.
If you're not Saio, who are you with?
Planting bombs isn't exactly a civilian thing.
You think I give up that easy?

That's it. It's time you tell me the truth.
Who are you with if not the Saio Triad?
Even if I tell you, you no know their name.

Our group famous in Kamurocho many years ago.
Back then, we even as strong as Tojo Clan.
My group called Snake Flower Triad!
Snake Flower...!

Right, I remember you guys.
It's been a while since I've heard that name.
You... know Snake Flower Triad?

They were the most brutal mafia in town,
led by a guy named Lau Ka Long.

Yes, exactly!
Oh man, I so happy now!

Lau tried to murder me when I was still a
junior Dojima Family man. I'm Kazuma Kiryu.

Kiryu? Kazuma Kiryu!?
You're... really him!?
So you guys are back in Kamurocho.
Are there any more of you?

Not really. Our leader is guy in mask
who was on the big screen before explosion.
Right. Makes sense.

Long ago, you crush Snake Flower Triad.
Now I here in Japan to rebuild from ground up.
Rebuild?

If only Lau Ka Long still alive.
Maybe this go well then. But...

Snake Flower officers realize their planning very poor.
So, they lose interest in Japan.

They lose interest in us, too.
Nobody even remember we here!
Your superiors literally forgot about you?

We no have money to go back home.
Day after day, we live here alone in this city.

Then Saio Triad arrives in Kamurocho.
They come later than us, then ignore us!

Now <font_kind=yakuza_italic>they</font_kind> at war with Tojo Clan.
Barely know Snake Flower exists! So humiliating!

Wait just a sec...
Do I have this straight?

The reason you set off that bomb...
is so people would notice you? Really?

We want to make Saio Triad pay
for embarrassment they cause us!

...I almost understand how slighted you feel,
but you need to stop antagonizing the Saio.

<font_kind=yakuza_italic>I</font_kind> managed to find you with barely any effort.
Imagine how easy it would be for them.

You wouldn't even stand a chance.
They'd slaughter you.
Ah... Dammit!

It's up to you... but don't throw your lives away.
I'll look past the bomb thing... this time.

I don't have time to deal with this nonsense.
Just go back to leading honest lives.

Kazuma Kiryu, the Dragon of Dojima.
We cannot defeat him now... We lose.

Kazuma Kiryu, yes?
I was under the impression you left Kamurocho.
The heir to the legacy of Lau Ka Long.

So the Snake Flower Triad?
What do you want?

I was simply hoping to make
an introduction in person.

Sorry, I'm not interested.
...Hm?
Up here, Kiryu.
Do you remember this man?

Your advice had a great impact on him.
He came to me begging to back off the Saio Triad.

In other words, he chose to disobey my orders.
And there is only one punishment for that.

Thanks to you, this man's life is forfeit.
If you want to stop me, go to where you last saw him.
Come alone. I'll be waiting.

The last place I saw him...
That would be the Yoshida Batting Center.

This is the place. The Snake Flower
should be waiting for me here…

Somehow...
That you, Kiryu?

So the Snake Flower would do
this to one of their own?

What about the man in the mask?
Where'd he go?
Right here... Kazuma Kiryu.

I'm surprised you came. I didn't imagine
this little punk would matter that much to you.

Is this really necessary?
You could've just talked to me from that screen.

Yes, I can't deny that. However, I have
some people here I'd like you to meet.

These are the Snake Flower elite forces,
sent directly from the homeland.

They were quick to arrive when I told
them I could give them Kazuma Kiryu.

You destroyed any hope we had of conquering Japan
so many years ago. We cannot forgive that.

And yet, our moronic friend here had different ideas.
He wanted to let you go free.

He claimed you weren't as bad as we said,
almost as though under the dragon's spell.

Between the screen hacking and the bomb placement,
though... nothing gets done unless <font_kind=yakuza_italic>I</font_kind> do it myself.
Pathetic, isn't it?
Couldn't say.

No matter. After I finish you once and for all,
the Snake Flower Triad will take Kamurocho for good.

And then, I will cement my position as
Lau Ka Long's successor. I will reign supreme.

Sounds like I don't have to hold back, then.
Someone as supreme as you can handle anything.

Very well.
I'll show you what true pain feels like, Kiryu!

I-I don't get it... This is impossible!
The Snake Flower was supposed to rise again...!
You sound ridiculous.

I'd never lose to even your best.
Your leadership needs to do the research.

You have a lot to learn if you want to rebuild.
Try following in the Saio Triad's footsteps.

They had the foresight to weasel into
Kamurocho with hundreds of men.

Their boss is a strategic mastermind as well.
He's not a common thug like you.
What... did you call me?

You're just as soft as everyone says, Kiryu.
You really won't finish me off?
If you let me leave here, you'll regret it.

You're in no position to be boasting.
Look around you.
Y-You...!

This traitor wanted to kill me.
I saved because of you, Kiryu.

You think I moron, huh?
You think you so much smarter than me!?

H-Hold on a second.
I didn't<symbol=em_dash_with_outline>

Shut your mouth!
You listen to me from now on!

Kazuma Kiryu. Nothing good happens
when my gang take you on.
To Snake Flower, you like poison.
Heh... True enough.

We keep our heads down for little bit.
I no kill this guy. Don't worry.

Good. That's the right call.
Bye, then.

If the Dragon of Dojima in Kamurocho,
the Saio be forced to leave someday.

Until then, we wait in shadows,
biding our time...

Well <font_kind=yakuza_italic>that's</font_kind> an interesting message.
No idea where she is, though. It's gotta be a prank.

This "Reiko" though... I can't say I'm not curious.
Wish I knew where she was...

It's her again.
Maybe I should go give her some company.
If only I could tell where she was...

Looks like she's on the move again.
Still alone too, from the sounds of it.
I wish I knew where she was...

Dammit, she already moved again?
She'll be mine this time!
Hey there.
Finally. I've been waiting, big boy.
H-Here I am.

You're even hotter than I was expecting.
I guess this means you saw my posts?
Yeah... That's how I ended up here.

Mmmm...
So, you wanna do it?
Let's go. I can't wait any longer.

My, you're like a wild animal. <symbol=note_with_outline>
By the way... mind telling me your name?
I'm gonna eat you up.

You hungry for some of this? In that case...
why don't you tell me <font_kind=yakuza_italic>just</font_kind> how tasty I look? <symbol=note_with_outline>

You're so cute when you're flustered.
Anyway... what's your name?

This feels kinda weird.
Are you sure this isn't some kind of trap?
Huhhh? Whaddya mean?
I mean, like blackmail. Am I wrong?

Of course you are. Calm down, big guy.
You get cold feet now that we're finally together?

You don't need to be nervous.
Let's just relax... like only adults can.

Hey, by the way...
you mind telling me your name?
My name...?

You don't need to know that.
Right now we're just man and woman.

But... it'll really get me going
if I can call you by your name. <symbol=note_with_outline>

I wanna have something to scream
when we're doing it... Is that so bad?
It's Makoto Date.

Date-san? That's a great name.
Come on, Date-san. Tell me you love me.
It's Kazuma Kiryu.

Kiryu-san? That's a great name.
Come on, Kiryu-san. Tell me you love me.
Tell you what...? Why?

I'm too embarrassed to ask again.
But... <font_kind=yakuza_italic>please</font_kind>? I need to hear you say it.

I love you, Reiko.
I need you.
Mmmm, yeah... That feels nice. <symbol=note_with_outline>
I can't say something if I don't mean it.

But if you don't love me, why'd you
chase me all the way out here?

You <font_kind=yakuza_italic>really</font_kind> thought you were gonna get lucky?
Think again, perv!

Okay, that's good!
I got all the footage I need.

Ya messed up real bad, old man.
That'll teach ya to go after cute girls online.

See, it don't get you any action.
Just a healthy servin' of humiliation.

You're a real pro at this, Reiko-san.
I'll get your share to ya later.

Sorry about this, Mister.
I had some fun with you<symbol=note_with_outline> Bye now!

Now then! If you don't want this shit all over
the internet, I'm gonna need two million yen.

Your wife n' kids're gonna be real sad
when they see it. Ya might even lose your job.
Thinkin' about it like that, two mil sounds pretty good, huh?

I get it now.
This is how these scams work nowadays.

It's how they're gonna keep workin', too.
Especially with chumps like you fallin' for it.

I think you're lucky number twenty.
Every other schmuck's paid their two million.

Sounds like this ruse has gone well for you.
It ends now, though.

Unlike me, I'm sure the other guys you tricked
had no way of deleting the footage from your phone.

Paying up was probably their only choice.
I won't go as easily as they did, though.
The hell're ya talkin' about, old man?

Well... I'm gonna get that phone
even if I have to beat it out of you.
Oh yeah!?
You punks are going to pay for trying to scam me.

You got guts, guy. I respect that.
But only a moron'd try n' fight all of us.

Kamurocho's a strange place, though. Every so often,
you'll find someone <font_kind=yakuza_italic>just</font_kind> moronic enough to do it.

You're funny, old man.
Now bring it on!
The hell...? I don't get it!

I want you to delete the video from your phones.
All the other ones you guys have taken, too.
Uh, but... those are...
Do it.
Y-Yessir!

Okay, they're all gone. I promise.
You can check if ya want.

I don't need to waste energy on that.
If you said you did it, you did it.

Ah... One more thing, though.
I want you all to smash your phones to bits.
You heard me. Use a hammer if you need to.
But... then...
Can't do it, huh?
I-I'll do it...
I like the sound of that.
My beautiful phone...

It's a fitting punishment. Maybe next time
you'll think twice before you blackmail people.

But damn, though...
I <font_kind=yakuza_italic>knew</font_kind> that Reiko was too good to be true.
Hm? Who could that be?
It's from Date-san.

That's weird. He's not really
the type to ask for favors.
"Sorry, I'm busy right now."

Hm... What could be that urgent?
I guess I should find out what's up.
"Yeah. What do you need me to do?"
Prepaid cards? What are those?
